contract.journey: Create + edit glossary translation in BO.

name: Glossary
rationale: Glossary translation created and edited in BO with the edited text asserted as the storefront page title and then reverted; no Cypress glossary spec.

contract.journey: checks that global minimum and maximum order thresholds can be applied.

name: Minimum_Order_Value
rationale: Same journey as parallel_ui/suite/misc/static_demodata_set.robot::Minimum_Order_Value (hard min/max plus soft threshold with fixed fee, surcharge in cart and summary, grand total); that variant uses dynamic fixtures and is the better port source.

contract.journey: Deactivate payment method, unset payment method for stores in zed and check its impact on yves.

name: Payment_method_update
rationale: Invoice payment method present at checkout, deactivated in BO, then absent at checkout; backoffice/configuration specs cover theme/logo settings only.

contract.journey: Verifies each left navigation node can be opened. DMS ON: https://spryker.atlassian.net/browse/FRW-7394.

name: Zed_navigation_ordering_and_naming
rationale: Three keywords that walk every left-navigation root and second-level node plus icons - broad but assertion-thin, and backoffice/acl/acl-navigation-access.cy.ts plus backoffice/navigation/menu-filter.cy.ts already exercise menu items from other angles.
recommended_action: port as a single cypress/e2e/backoffice/navigation/navigation-smoke.cy.ts that opens each node

contract.journey: Checks customer data and checkout as an agent.

name: Agent_Assist
rationale: Agent logs in on the storefront, searches a customer, impersonates them, reads their profile and completes a checkout on their behalf; the mp/marketplace-agent-assist specs all impersonate merchant users in the Merchant Portal, not customers on Yves.

contract.journey: Create a user with limited access.

name: User_Control
rationale: BO role with an explicit deny rule, group, and user; the denied action returns 'Access denied' and a deactivated user cannot log in. backoffice/acl/acl-navigation-access.cy.ts covers allow/deny at navigation and path level but not action-level deny or user deactivation.
recommended_action: port the action-deny and deactivation deltas into cypress/e2e/backoffice/acl/acl-navigation-access.cy.ts

contract.journey: Bug: https://spryker.atlassian.net/browse/CC-12380.

name: Unique_URL
rationale: Regression for CC-12380: external cart-sharing link generated, customer logs out, and the anonymous preview shows the cart name and its items; no Cypress shared-cart-link spec.

contract.journey: Checks role permissions on checkout and Approval process.

name: Approval_Process
rationale: Cart approval feature: buyer with a spend limit sends a cart for approval, cart is locked and read-only, approver approves it and the buyer then places the order. Not skipped in b2b, though the suite copy of this test is fully commented out ('DEMODATA - NO OOT LIMITS AND CAN'T SET THEM IN SUITE'), so it only runs on b2b. yves/purchasing-control/budget-enforcement.cy.ts is the budget feature, not quote approval.

contract.journey: Guest checkout with discounts, OMS and different addresses.

name: Guest_Checkout_and_Addresses
rationale: Merges the two suite guest journeys (voucher plus cart rule from Guest_Checkout, three delivery addresses and Zed address assertions from Guest_Checkout_Addresses) into one marketplace variant; basic-checkout.cy.ts already covers the guest multi-shipment flow itself.

contract.journey: Checks that business unit address can be used during checkout.

name: Business_Unit_Address_on_Checkout
rationale: Company-user picks the business-unit address at checkout and it is asserted on the order-details page; no Cypress company-account checkout-address spec.

contract.journey: Bug: CC-30439. Checks that user can change address during the checkout and save new into the address book.

name: Checkout_Address_Management
rationale: Regression for CC-30439: separate billing address, step-back to the address step, save-to-address-book toggles, then assertions in the customer address book and on the Zed order; no Cypress equivalent.

contract.journey: checks that product offer is successfully replaced with a target product offer.

name: Click_and_collect
rationale: Three offers with service points and shipment types created in MP, approved in BO, then pickup selection with per-store availability and pickup shipping cost asserted on the order; no Cypress click-and-collect spec (ssp-service.cy.ts only groups items by shipment type).

contract.journey: Editing and deleting comments in carts.

covered_by: cypress/e2e/yves/comments/cart-comments.cy.ts :: 'customer should be able to modify comment in cart with items' and 'customer should be able to remove comment in cart with items'
name: Comment_Management_in_the_Cart
rationale: Add, edit and delete a cart comment with visibility assertions after each step - identical to the Cypress cart-comment edit/remove tests (duplication analysis scores this pair 0.58, the highest in the report).

contract.journey: Add comments to cart and verify comments in Yves and Zed.

name: Comments_in_Cart
rationale: Adding a cart comment is covered by yves/comments/cart-comments.cy.ts; the uncovered delta is that the comment survives checkout and appears on the Yves order-details page and the Zed order page.

contract.journey: Configurable product checkout

name: Configurable_Product_Checkout
rationale: Same journey as parallel_ui/suite/catalog/catalog_configurable_product.robot::Configurable_Product_Checkout (two-option configurator, reconfigure in cart, checkout, Zed grand total); that variant uses dynamic fixtures and is the better port source.

contract.journey: Guest checkout with bundles, discounts and OMS.

name: Guest_Checkout
rationale: Guest checkout itself is covered by basic-checkout.cy.ts 'guest customer should checkout to single shipment' and the OMS tail by smoke/order-management/dummy-payment-oms-flow.cy.ts; the uncovered delta is the bundle plus voucher and cart-rule discounts in a guest cart.
recommended_action: port only the guest voucher/cart-rule/bundle delta into cypress/e2e/yves/discount/discounts-and-promotions.cy.ts

contract.journey: Guest checkout with different addresses and OMS.

name: Guest_Checkout_Addresses
rationale: basic-checkout.cy.ts 'guest customer should checkout to multi shipment address' covers the flow; the delta is three distinct per-item delivery addresses plus per-shipment method choice and the Zed billing/shipping address assertions.

contract.journey: Login during checkout

name: Login_during_checkout
rationale: Guest starts checkout then authenticates mid-flow and completes with a new address; basic-checkout.cy.ts only has pure-guest and pre-logged-in paths.

contract.journey: Checks that order with products and offers of multiple merchants could be placed and it will be split per merchant.

name: Multiple_Merchants_Order
rationale: Cart mixing main-merchant product and two merchant offers, merchant asserted per cart line, order split into three shipments; no Cypress multi-merchant order-split spec.

contract.journey: Guest user email should be whitelisted from the AWS side before running the test.

name: Register_during_checkout
rationale: Guest signs up mid-checkout, confirms registration, completes the order and profile data is asserted; not covered by customer-auth.cy.ts (registration there is standalone).

contract.journey: Checks user can request and receive quote.

name: Request_for_Quote
rationale: Complete RfQ lifecycle: submit, send to agent, agent revises price, customer edits items and adds a note, valid-till date, convert to cart, checkout; Cypress has no quote-request coverage.

contract.journey: Checks split delivery in checkout.

name: Split_Delivery
rationale: Multi-address split delivery with three different shipment carriers and a Zed shipment count of 3; basic-checkout.cy.ts already exercises isMultiShipment but never asserts per-shipment carrier or the shipment count.

contract.journey: Create a new company user on Storefront.

name: Create_new_company_user_with_linked_entities_in_storefront
rationale: Storefront creation of company role, business unit and company user plus the same 403 permission proof via agent impersonation; yves/company-account specs only assign an existing role.

contract.journey: Create a new company with linked entities and new customer in backoffice.

name: Create_new_company_with_linked_entities_and_customer_in_backoffice
rationale: Back-office creation of company, business unit, company role with scoped permission and company user, then agent impersonation proving /company/user is reachable and /company/company-role returns 403; backoffice/company-account/company-role-create.cy.ts only opens the create page.

contract.journey: Checks cms content can be edited in zed and that correct cms elements are present on homepage.

name: Content_Management
rationale: CMS page created and published in Zed then its title and content blocks asserted on the storefront URL; Cypress cms specs only search for an existing CMS page (yves/cms/cms-page-search-dms.cy.ts).

contract.journey: Check creation of wishlist and adding to different wishlists.

name: Add_to_Wishlist
rationale: Multiple named wishlists, add from PDP to a chosen list, and the guest cannot-add path; no Cypress wishlist spec exists.

contract.journey: Checks that authorized users see products info, cart and profile.

name: Authorized_User_Access
rationale: Navigation smoke: header icons plus 'Overview / Order History / Wishlist page is displayed' assertions with one add-to-cart; no state change, and login itself is already covered by yves/customer-account-management/customer-auth.cy.ts.

contract.journey: Check that BoB user has possibility to change the business unit.

name: Business_on_Behalf
rationale: Company user attached to a second business unit in Zed then the storefront business-unit selector offers both; no Cypress business-on-behalf spec.

contract.journey: Check that a new user cannot login if the email is not verified.

name: Email_Confirmation
rationale: Registers a customer then proves login is refused before the email is confirmed - the negative half that customer-auth.cy.ts does not cover.

contract.journey: Checks that guest users see products info and cart but not profile.

name: Guest_User_Access_Restrictions
rationale: Mostly presence assertions, but it does prove a guest is redirected to login for account overview and wishlist while cart and PDP stay reachable - an access-control behaviour no Cypress spec asserts.

contract.journey: Check that a new user can be registered in the system.

name: New_Customer_Registration
rationale: Registers a customer and asserts only the confirm-your-email flash; customer-auth.cy.ts 'guest should be able to register and login as new customer' covers registration, so the delta is just the confirmation-required message (duplication analysis scores this pair 0.52).

contract.journey: Checks Quick Order, checkout and Reorder.

name: Quick_Order
rationale: Quick-order textarea bulk add plus search-and-add with merchant choice, into both a cart and a shopping list, then checkout and reorder with merchant assertions; no Cypress quick-order spec.

contract.journey: Checks that merchant relation is saved with reorder.

name: Reorder
rationale: Places an order and reorders it asserting the merchant is preserved - yves/reorder/reorder-product-offers.cy.ts asserts exactly that ('Sold by <merchant>' after reorderAll), but that spec is skipped on b2c/b2b repos while this Robot test runs on suite.
recommended_action: drop; merchant-preserving reorder is already asserted in cypress/e2e/yves/reorder/reorder-product-offers.cy.ts - only keep if that spec's b2c/b2b skip matters

contract.journey: Checks that cart can be shared and used for checkout.

name: Share_Shopping_Carts
rationale: Cart shared with full access to another company user who then completes checkout from it; no Cypress shared-cart spec.

contract.journey: Checks that shopping list can be shared.

name: Share_Shopping_Lists
rationale: Shopping list shared with a second company user in a second browser context, merchant/offer relation preserved in the list and after add-all-to-cart; no Cypress shopping-list spec.

contract.journey: Checks that customer is able to add merchant products and offers to list and merchant relation won't be lost in list and afterwards in cart.

name: Shopping_List_Contains_Offers
rationale: Merchant product and offer added to a shopping list, merchant relation asserted in list and cart; no Cypress shopping-list spec.

contract.journey: Checks customer data can be updated from Yves and Zed.

name: Update_Customer_Data
rationale: Profile edited on Yves, verified in Zed, edited in Zed, verified back on Yves; no Cypress profile-edit spec.

contract.journey: Checks user account pages work + address management.

name: User_Account
rationale: Customer address-book create, assert, delete on the storefront plus an address created in Zed appearing in the storefront; no Cypress address-management spec.

contract.journey: Checks that customer is able to add merchant products and offers to list and merchant relation won't be lost in list and afterwards in cart.

name: Wishlist_List_Supports_Offers
rationale: Merchant product and merchant offer both added to one wishlist, merchant relation asserted in the list and again in the cart after add-all; no Cypress wishlist spec.

contract.journey: CRUD operations for product sets. DMS-ON: https://spryker.atlassian.net/browse/FRW-7393.

name: CRUD_Product_Set
rationale: Product set created in BO, its storefront URL verified with three products and add-all-to-cart, then deleted and the URL 404s; no Cypress product-set spec.

contract.journey: Check the usage of configurable bundles (includes authorized checkout).

name: Configurable_Bundle
rationale: Configurable-bundle template selection, two slot configurations, quantity change in cart, checkout and OMS to Close, with the bundle title counted on the order-details page; no Cypress configurable-bundle spec.

contract.journey: Discounts, Promo Products, and Coupon Codes (includes guest checkout).

name: Discounts
rationale: Same journey as parallel_ui/suite/misc/static_demodata_set.robot::Discounts (voucher, cart rule, promotional product, exact discount amounts, checkout grand total); that variant uses dynamic fixtures and DB-level discount deactivation and is the better port source.

contract.journey: Checks related product on PDP and upsell products in cart.

name: Product_Relations
rationale: Related products present/absent on two PDPs and up-selling products shown in the cart; no Cypress product-relation spec (the 0.52 match against product-attribute-visibility.cy.ts is helper noise, that spec asserts attribute badges).

contract.journey: Check the usage of product sets.

name: Product_Sets
rationale: Product-sets index, a set detail page with variant switching, add-all-to-cart and per-SKU cart assertions; no Cypress product-set spec.

contract.journey: Checks that products have labels on PLP and PDP.

name: Product_labels
rationale: Sale and New labels asserted on the catalog card and again on PDP after navigating the Sale/New navigation nodes; no Cypress product-label spec.

contract.journey: Checks that customer is able to add merchant products and offers to list and merchant relation won't be lost in list and afterwards in cart.

name: Shopping_List_Contains_Offers
rationale: Marketplace-B2B variant of tests/ui/suite/customers/customer.robot::Shopping_List_Contains_Offers - identical steps with a different merchant name.

contract.journey: Checks that merchant is able to create new offer and it will be displayed on Yves.

name: Create_New_Offer
rationale: Merchant creates a product then an offer on another merchant's concrete, adds a EUR price row, and the storefront shows the offer price and carries the merchant into the cart; mp/data-import/merchant-combined-product-offer.cy.ts reaches the same end state via CSV import, not through the Merchant Portal UI.

contract.journey: Checks that merchant is able to create new multi-SKU product and marketplace operator is able to approve it in BO.

name: Create_and_Approve_New_Merchant_Product
rationale: Merchant creates a multi-SKU product, BO approves, PDP shows it, BO denies and the PDP 404s - a strict subset of Manage_Merchant_Product plus a deny path, and mp/data-import/merchant-combined-product.cy.ts already covers merchant product to PDP via import.

contract.journey: Checks that marketplace operator is able to approve or deny merchant's offer and it will be available or not in store due to this status.

name: Approve_Offer
rationale: Operator denies then approves an offer in BO and 'Sold by' plus the offer price appear/disappear on the storefront PDP; backoffice/product-offer/product-offer.cy.ts only creates an offer.

contract.journey: Checks that default merchants are present in Zed.

name: Default_Merchants
rationale: Opens the BO merchant table and asserts three seeded merchant names are present; a demo-data presence assertion, not a journey.

contract.journey: Checks that merchant is able to process his order through OMS from merchant portal.

name: Fulfill_Order_from_Merchant_Portal
rationale: Merchant-side OMS in MP overlaps mp/marketplace-order-management/order-creation.cy.ts, which already closes an order as a merchant user; the delta is the four-line multi-merchant cart, the MP grand total and per-item Ship/Deliver states on the Items tab.
recommended_action: port the per-item state and multi-merchant delta into cypress/e2e/mp/marketplace-order-management/order-creation.cy.ts

contract.journey: Checks that MU and BO user can manage merchant abstract and concrete products + add new concrete product.

name: Manage_Merchant_Product
rationale: Merchant creates a product with per-concrete prices, tiered price and stock, BO approves, storefront verifies each variant price and the availability error, then a third concrete is added and BO price/name edits are re-verified. mp/marketplace-product-concretes/product-concrete-management.cy.ts only asserts the concretes table renders.

contract.journey: Checks that backoffice admin is able to create, activate, edit and delete merchant users. DMS-ON: https://spryker.atlassian.net/browse/FRW-7395.

name: Manage_Merchant_Users
rationale: BO merchant-user create/activate/edit/deactivate with MP login allowed then refused; mp/marketplace-agent-assist/agent-login.cy.ts already asserts deactivated and deleted merchant users cannot log in, so only the BO CRUD half is new.
recommended_action: port the BO CRUD half as cypress/e2e/backoffice/merchant-management/merchant-user-management.cy.ts

contract.journey: Checks that backoffice admin is able to create, approve, edit merchants.

name: Manage_Merchants_from_Backoffice
rationale: Create merchant, activate, approve access, edit name, verify the merchant page on Yves, unassign stores and verify the URL 404s; no Cypress merchant CRUD spec.

contract.journey: Checks that customer will see product/offer prices specified by merchant for his business unit.

name: Merchant_Portal_Customer_Specific_Prices
rationale: Merchant sets a business-unit-specific concrete price in MP; two different storefront users then see 100 vs 500, and the price falls back after the row is removed. No Cypress equivalent.

contract.journey: Checks that merchant user is able to access the dashboard page. DMS-ON: https://spryker.atlassian.net/browse/FRW-7395.

name: Merchant_Portal_Dashboard
rationale: After a large BO setup it only clicks three dashboard buttons and checks the resulting URL fragments; a navigation smoke with no state change.

contract.journey: Checks that MU can edit personal data in MP. DMS-ON: https://spryker.atlassian.net/browse/FRW-7395.

name: Merchant_Portal_My_Account
rationale: Merchant user edits name and password in MP, re-logs in with the new password and the change is visible in the BO user table; mp/multi-factor-authentication/merchant-user-mfa-auth.cy.ts already covers MP password change and re-login, so only the name edit and BO verification are new.

contract.journey: Checks that merchant is able to create new offer with volume prices and it will be displayed on Yves. Fallback to default price after delete.

name: Merchant_Portal_Offer_Volume_Prices
rationale: Same tier-and-fallback journey but on an offer with three price rows across currencies; no Cypress offer-price spec.

contract.journey: Checks that merchant is able to create new multi-SKU product with volume prices. Fallback to default price after delete.

name: Merchant_Portal_Product_Volume_Prices
rationale: Merchant creates a multi-SKU product with a quantity price row, BO approves, storefront shows the tiered price at qty 4, then the row is deleted and the price falls back; no Cypress MP volume-price spec.

contract.journey: Check that when root URL for MerchantPortal is opened by unauthorized user he is redirected to login page.

name: Merchant_Portal_Unauthorized_Access_Redirects_To_Login_Page
rationale: Deletes cookies, opens the MP root URL and asserts a login div plus the resulting URL - a bare redirect/render check with no journey; MP login itself is covered by smoke/merchant-portal/login.cy.ts.

contract.journey: Check View action and filtration for Mproduct and Moffer in backoffice.

name: Merchant_Product_Offer_in_Backoffice
rationale: Merchant filter plus the View action for both a merchant product and a merchant offer, with a table of expected view-page fields; backoffice/product-offer/product-offer.cy.ts asserts view-page data only for an offer it just created and does not cover the merchant filter.

contract.journey: checks that Original price is displayed on the PDP and in Catalog.

name: Merchant_Product_Original_Price
rationale: Merchant sets a gross-original price in MP and the strike-through price is asserted on the catalog card and PDP; same assertion shape as the non-merchant Product_Original_Price so it should extend that spec.

contract.journey: Checks that backoffice admin is able to deactivate merchant and then it's profile, products and offers won't be displayed on Yves.

name: Merchant_Profile_Set_to_Inactive_from_Backoffice
rationale: Operator deactivates the merchant in BO and profile plus offers vanish from the storefront; no Cypress merchant-deactivation spec.

contract.journey: Checks that merchant is able to set store offline and then his profile, products and offers won't be displayed on Yves.

name: Merchant_Profile_Set_to_Offline_from_MP
rationale: Merchant sets the store offline in MP and the profile page plus 'Sold by' on three PDPs disappear on Yves; no Cypress equivalent.

contract.journey: Checks that merchant profile could be updated from merchant portal and that changes will be displayed on Yves.

name: Merchant_Profile_Update
rationale: Merchant edits online-profile fields in MP and the storefront merchant page reflects them; no Cypress merchant-profile spec (merchant-registration.cy.ts covers registration only).

contract.journey: check offer availability.

name: Offer_Availability_Calculation
rationale: Offer stock of 5 enforced on PDP, reduced to 2 after checkout and restored to 5 after the merchant shipment is cancelled, across two stores; no Cypress offer-availability spec.

contract.journey: Checks that through search customer is able to see the list of merchant's products and offers.

name: Search_for_Merchant_Offers_and_Products
rationale: Search by merchant name, sort, and the Merchant facet filter, each verified via 'Sold by' on the first PDP; Cypress catalog specs have no merchant facet coverage.

contract.journey: Conf Product OMS check and reorder.

name: Configurable_Product_OMS
rationale: Ten-option configurator on two variants, the stored configuration asserted on the Zed order, OMS through refund, a storefront return with print slip, and reorder showing the configuration reset; no Cypress configurator coverage.

contract.journey: Add comments in Yves and check in Zed.

name: Comment_Management_in_Order
rationale: Comment added on the storefront order-details page and then found on the Zed order page; yves/comments/cart-comments.cy.ts is cart-scoped only.

contract.journey: Checks create/edit shipment functions from backoffice.

name: Manage_Shipments
rationale: Back-office create and edit of shipments inside an order, with shipment count, per-shipment addresses, methods, costs, requested delivery date and item allocation asserted; no Cypress shipment-management spec.

contract.journey: Check that customer is able to cancel order.

name: Order_Cancellation
rationale: Customer cancels an order from the storefront and the cancel button then disappears once items are paid; yves/order-amendment/order-amendment-cancel.cy.ts cancels an amendment, a different feature.

contract.journey: Checks that refund can be created for one item and the whole order.

name: Refunds
rationale: Order driven to Shipped then refunded per item with the grand total asserted at each step down to 0.00; no Cypress refund spec (commission-calculation.cy.ts refunds commissions, not order items).

contract.journey: Checks that returns work and oms process is checked.

name: Return_Management
rationale: Storefront return creation with print-slip contents, merchant Execute-return in MP, a BO-created return, an agent-created return and the order reaching Returned. backoffice/return-management/return-creation.cy.ts only creates a return from the BO side.

contract.journey: checks that product offer is successfully replaced with a target product offer.

name: Click_and_collect
rationale: Marketplace-B2C variant of tests/ui/suite/checkout/checkout.robot::Click_and_collect with dynamic fixtures; same three-offer service-point pickup journey.

contract.journey: Discounts, Promo Products, and Coupon Codes (includes guest checkout).

name: Discounts
rationale: Voucher, cart rule and promotional-product discounts created in BO, each discount amount asserted in the cart, promo product added, then split-shipment checkout with the grand total verified; no Cypress discount spec exists (gift-cards is the only payment-adjacent one).

contract.journey: Fulfillment app e2e

name: Fulfillment_app_e2e
rationale: Same shape as the b2c copy: warehouse assignment, order creation and the whole picking-list flow are BAPI/Glue with response-body assertions; only the warehouse-user flag and the OMS state waits use the browser. Split into an API picking test plus a thin BO spec.

contract.journey: checks that global minimum and maximum order thresholds can be applied.

name: Minimum_Order_Value
rationale: Hard min/max thresholds and a soft threshold with a fixed fee configured in BO, the surcharge asserted in cart and on the summary, the max-threshold block message, and the final grand total; no Cypress minimum-order-value spec.

contract.journey: DMS-ON: https://spryker.atlassian.net/browse/FRW-7396.

name: Data_exchange_API_Configuration_in_Zed
rationale: Only the first half is a browser journey (creating the mime-types dynamic-entity configuration in Zed); the assertions are POST/PATCH/GET calls against /dynamic-entity/mime-types with response-body checks. Split: keep the BO configuration form as a Cypress spec and move the CRUD assertions to the Glue/BAPI API suite.

contract.journey: DMS-ON: https://spryker.atlassian.net/browse/FRW-7396.

name: Data_exchange_API_download_specification
rationale: Back-office journey: download button enabled/disabled state, specification downloaded and its contents checked, new dynamic-entity configuration created and the regenerated specification re-checked; no Cypress data-exchange spec.

contract.journey: Conf Product OMS check and reorder.

name: Configurable_Product_OMS
rationale: Marketplace variant of tests/ui/b2c/sales/sales.robot::Configurable_Product_OMS with dynamic fixtures; the delta is the Merchant Portal order grand total and the merchant shipment states, while the b2c copy carries the return and reorder tail.

contract.journey: Configurable product checkout

name: Configurable_Product_Checkout
rationale: Configurator on PDP, reconfiguration in the cart with the unit price changing, checkout and Zed grand total - dynamic-fixture variant, the better port source of the two Configurable_Product_Checkout copies; no Cypress configurator coverage.

contract.journey: Checks Quick Order, checkout and Reorder.

name: Quick_Order
rationale: B2B variant of tests/ui/suite/customers/customer.robot::Quick_Order - same textarea bulk add, cart and shopping list, checkout and reorder, only with B2B SKUs and without the merchant assertions.

contract.journey: check offer availability.

name: Offer_Availability_Calculation
rationale: Marketplace-B2C variant of tests/ui/suite/marketplace/marketplace.robot::Offer_Availability_Calculation - same offer stock/checkout/cancel availability cycle.

contract.journey: Back in stock notification is sent and availability check.

name: Back_in_Stock_Notification
rationale: Stock set to zero in Zed, availability-notification subscribe and unsubscribe on PDP, then PDP availability after restock; no Cypress availability-notification spec.

contract.journey: Checks that catalog options and search work.

name: Catalog
rationale: Facet filtering (Color), navigation drill-down, result counts, price asc/desc sorting, pagination and the filter list; Cypress catalog coverage is only suggestion search (smoke/catalog/product-search.cy.ts, yves/catalog/product-search-dms.cy.ts) with no filter/sort/paging assertions.

contract.journey: Checks quick add to cart and product groups.

name: Catalog_Actions
rationale: Quick add-to-cart from the catalog card, colour selector on the card and a Zed price change reflected in the cart line; no Cypress spec touches catalog-card actions.

contract.journey: Configure products from both the PDP and the Shopping List. Verify the availability of five items. Ensure that products that have not been configured cannot be purchased.

name: Configurable_Product_PDP_Shopping_List
rationale: Unconfigured item blocks checkout, configuration edited from PDP, cart and shopping list, availability cap of 5 enforced; no Cypress configurator coverage.

contract.journey: Configure product from PDP and Wishlist + availability case.

name: Configurable_Product_PDP_Wishlist_Availability
rationale: Product configurator driven from PDP and again from a wishlist entry, with a no-availability configuration notification; Cypress has no product-configurator specs at all.

contract.journey: Conf Product in RfQ, OMS, Merchant OMS and reorder.

name: Configurable_Product_RfQ_OMS
rationale: Configured item through RfQ with agent revision, convert-to-cart, checkout, merchant OMS to refund and reorder; no Cypress quote-request specs exist.

contract.journey: Checks that product price can be different for different customers.

name: Customer_Specific_Prices
rationale: Same SKU priced differently for a plain customer and a company user, asserted in catalog, PDP and cart; no Cypress merchant-relation price spec.

contract.journey: Checks discontinued and alternative products.

name: Discontinued_Alternative_Products
rationale: Discontinue a product in Zed, attach alternatives, then assert discontinued/alternative markers in the storefront wishlist; no Cypress equivalent.

contract.journey: checks that BO user can manage abstract and concrete products + create new.

name: Manage_Product
rationale: Full back-office abstract/concrete lifecycle: create with variants, per-variant prices and stock, approve, verify each variant price and the availability error on the storefront, add a concrete, rename, verify BO view page. Cypress publish-and-synchronize.cy.ts only creates one product and checks it appears.

contract.journey: Checks checkout with Measurement Unit product.

name: Measurement_Units
rationale: Sales-unit selection and quantity suggestion on PDP followed by a full checkout; Cypress measurement-unit specs are back-office only (product-measurement-unit-create/list.cy.ts), no storefront journey.

contract.journey: Checks checkout with Packaging Unit product.

name: Packaging_Units
rationale: Packaging-unit amount input, amount suggestion and checkout of the packaged concrete; no Cypress packaging-unit coverage on any surface.

contract.journey: Check product availability + multistore.

name: Product_Availability_Calculation
rationale: Warehouse-to-store assignment, per-quantity availability errors, stock returned after order cancellation and per-store availability; no Cypress availability spec.

contract.journey: Checks checkout with Bundle product.

name: Product_Bundles
rationale: Bundle PDP shows bundled items, bundle added to cart and checked out; Cypress only reorders an already-placed bundle (yves/reorder/reorder-product-bundles.cy.ts), never buys one.

contract.journey: checks that Original price is displayed on the PDP and in Catalog.

name: Product_Original_Price
rationale: Original (strike-through) price asserted on the catalog card and on PDP for two variants; no Cypress spec asserts original price.

contract.journey: Checks that PDP contains required elements.

name: Product_PDP
rationale: Body is a sequence of 'PDP contains/doesn't contain' element-presence checks for guest vs logged-in plus a variant switch; the guest/customer element delta is real but no Cypress spec covers PDP element visibility (product-attribute-visibility.cy.ts covers attribute badges only).

contract.journey: Checks White and Black lists.

name: Product_Restrictions
rationale: White/black product lists assigned to a merchant relation and per-customer search visibility asserted both ways; no Cypress product-list/restriction spec.

contract.journey: Checks that volume prices are applied in cart.

name: Volume_Prices
rationale: Quantity-tiered price on PDP carried into a named cart; no Cypress volume-price coverage exists (grep of cypress/e2e finds none).

contract.journey: This test should exclusively run for dynamic multi-store scenarios. The test verifies that the user can successfully create a new store, assign a product and CMS page, and register a customer within the new store.

name: Dynamic_multistore
rationale: Creates a store in BO then assigns product, price, warehouse, CMS page and CMS blocks to it and registers a customer inside it; the deepest DMS journey in the suite and nothing in Cypress creates a store.

contract.journey: check CMS multistore functionality.

name: Multistore_CMS
rationale: CMS page published to both stores, verified on the AT store, then unassigned from AT and the URL 404s; api/cms and yves/cms specs only search for a page.

contract.journey: check product multistore functionality.

name: Multistore_Product
rationale: Product created for DE and AT with per-store prices, verified in catalog card, PDP and cart on both stores, then the AT store is unassigned and the URL 404s; yves/core/locale-switching.cy.ts covers locales, not per-store product scoping.

contract.journey: check product and offer multistore functionality.

name: Multistore_Product_Offer
rationale: Merchant product and offer scoped to DE and AT with different per-store prices, offer unassigned from AT and then the product unassigned until the URL 404s; no Cypress equivalent.

contract.journey: DMS-ON: https://spryker.atlassian.net/browse/FRW-7463.

name: Fulfillment_app_e2e
rationale: The browser is incidental: only the warehouse-user checkbox and a few Zed OMS clicks are UI, while order creation, warehouse assignment and the whole picking-list start/pick flow with its status assertions are Glue and BAPI calls plus direct DB updates. Split into an API test for picking plus a thin BO spec for the warehouse-user flag.
